coverage.headline: 2 of 10 obligations are enforced by code; 7 need human review; 5 informational sentences, 1 unaccounted (1 via human-approved extensions)

sentences.sentence: We believe you will be thrilled with the products you purchase from the Apple Store.
sentences.label: informational

sentences.sentence: In the unlikely event a product is not what you expected, you can return or exchange it with a receipt within 14 days of the date you receive the product from Apple.
sentences.label: enforced

sentences.sentence: The product must be in its original condition with all of its included parts, accessories, and packaging and we’ll exchange it or offer a refund based on the payment method.
sentences.label: needs_review
sentences.reason: No primitive checks product condition, included parts, packaging, or payment-method-based exchange or refund.

sentences.sentence: Apple products purchased through other retailers must be returned to those retailers in accordance with their returns and refunds policies.
sentences.label: needs_review
sentences.reason: No primitive tracks purchase retailer or enforces another retailer's return policy.

sentences.sentence: Products can be returned only in the country where purchased.
sentences.label: enforced

sentences.sentence: For returns for cash or cash equivalent over $750, Apple will mail a refund check to you within 10 business days.
sentences.label: needs_review
sentences.reason: No primitive expresses a payment-method threshold or mailing a refund check within business days; a cap would incorrectly forbid amounts over $750.

sentences.sentence: For returns with a gift receipt, Apple will offer you an Apple Gift Card.
sentences.label: needs_review
sentences.reason: No primitive tracks gift receipts or issues a gift card.

sentences.sentence: For returns paid with your Apple Account balance, Apple will refund the portion paid to your Apple Account or, if unable, an Apple Gift Card.
sentences.label: needs_review
sentences.reason: No primitive tracks payment source or routes refunds between account balance and a gift card.

sentences.sentence: If approved, a refund or exchange will be issued within 10 business days.
sentences.label: needs_review
sentences.reason: No primitive measures a business-day deadline from approval; the available date primitive measures calendar days from an entity date.

sentences.sentence: Apple provides security features to protect your product in case of loss or theft.
sentences.label: informational

sentences.sentence: If these features were activated and cannot be disabled by the person in possession, Apple may refuse the return or exchange.
sentences.label: informational

sentences.sentence: To return ten or more of the same product, you must return to the Apple Store where purchased.
sentences.label: needs_review
sentences.reason: No primitive expresses a same-product quantity threshold or return-store location requirement.

sentences.sentence: For complete details on how to return a product purchased at the Apple Store please visit the Returns & Refunds page.
sentences.label: informational

disclaimer: These are small synthetic corpora, so the counts are a demonstration on invented cases, not a measure of performance on real customers.
